description: This file defines the LangString class, which models a language string entity with properties like unitId, groupId, value, version, and note. It includes methods to retrieve these properties and a static factory method to create an instance from an array.

classes.name: LangString
classes.description: A data transfer object representing a language string with associated metadata, providing accessor methods and a factory method for instantiation from an array.

methods.name: getUnitId
methods.description: Returns the unit ID of the language string.

methods.name: getGroupId
methods.description: Returns the group ID associated with the language string.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the value/content of the language string.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version of the language string, if set.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Returns any note associated with the language string.

methods.name: createFromArray
methods.description: Creates a new LangString instance from an associative array.
